svg.title: Binit adds 8.4 ms to a new shell with 50 plugins; Zinit adds 87.2 ms to Zsh
svg.desc: Ready to type: Binit adds 8.4 ms over Bash sourcing the plugins directly; Zinit adds 87.2 ms over Zsh doing the same. All 50 plugins loaded: Binit adds 10.7 ms over Bash sourcing the plugins directly; Zinit adds 316 ms over Zsh doing the same.
